SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Represents a user's financial savings goal with target amount, current saved balance, optional target deadline, currency symbol, and accent color.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this savings goal.

title.description: Display name of the savings goal (1 to 100 characters).

targetAmount.description: Total target amount to save (strictly greater than 0).

currentAmount.description: Currently accumulated amount for this goal (0 or greater).

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol displayed inside the circular gauge (e.g. ₽, $, €).

colorHex.description: Hex color string for the circular progress gauge accent.

targetDateMillis.description: Optional target completion date in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the goal was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the goal was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GoalTransaction.title: GoalTransaction
GoalTransaction.description: Represents a single deposit or withdrawal contribution towards a specific savings goal.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this transaction.

goalId.description: The document ID of the parent SavingsGoal.

amount.description: Signed transaction amount (positive for deposit, negative for withdrawal, non-zero).

note.description: Short note or label describing the contribution (0 to 200 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/goals/{goalId}.description: Stores user-owned savings goals isolated under the authenticated user's UID.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Stores user-owned savings transactions isolated under the authenticated user's UID.
